title: My Weigh KD-8000 Digital Food Scale, Stainless Steel, Silver
reviews_5s:
I bought one of these 5 years ago and loved it and just had to buy a new one I put the first one through the ringer with my soaping business can't go wrong in buying this the quality is good the right size not to big or to small works great. I bought a food grade one and didn't like it so went back to this one. I would like the cost to be a little better but don't we all. I would still buy this again if needed in 5 years.I love this scale! I started baking to manage gluten and find it very easy to use. No more multiple measuring cups or spoons or bowls unless you want to separate liquids and dry ingredients. The scale has a larger platform with the readout and buttons in the front so you can always read it. The control panel is protected so you don’t have to worry about sticky batter or flour getting into the keypad, and it has a function that automatically subtracts the weight of the bowl. I’ve used small cups to huge bowls on it and can still easily see what the weight is.I think this is my 8th scale. But only because I give a lot of them away as gifts. My daughter has one that is 20 yrs old, still works flawlessly every day, looks good, needs batteries about every 6 years if you buy good batteries. But now that MyWeigh has been sold to a new company I expect these to be gone when the current inventory is exhausted and I won't know where to go to get a duplicate of the known good design.Love it, love it. works well, tottaly functional. size is just right. pretty accurate. value for money a 10!!
light weight which is great!!!This scale is awesome . I’ve tried several other scales, including some of the top brands, and this thing works better than all of them. Highly recommend it. It reads fast and also does a pretty good job with very small amounts. I was surprised at that because most big kitchen scales don’t do well with a few grams But this one did. Highly recommend. It’s also nice that you can plug this thing in and you don’t need batteries.My first scale came in with shipping damage. My replacement was sent right out. Both arrived early. Great customer service. Loving the new one it works great. Portions are important in catering.We have found this scale works well and the weight seems pretty accurate. My granddaughter like to bake she was very impressed with it too.
I think it was a good value.awesome scale. very precise. love that you can remove the digital reader cover. also love that it can be battery operated or plugged in. seems to be very durable as well and easy to clean. i use this scale in a professional kitchen. it makes graming out recipes a breeze.I bought this scale primarily for weighing out quantities of ingredients used in making violin varnish. The capacity of up to 8 kg makes it ideal for the amounts that I need to weigh. Additionally, I like the fact that this scale uses a plug-in power transformer instead of having to rely on batteries. There will be long periods where I will not use the scale, and unused batteries tend to seep chemicals over time which will corrode the terminals. This scale seems to be rather rugged and designed for durability. The digital readout is large, but being an LCD, I have to stand at the correct angle to see the numbers at the greatest contrast with the gray background.This scale is great!
reviews_1s: Never had a more frustrating experience with a product. Manual has a long spiel against using batteries as they are the primary source of inaccurate weighings. Thanks for the heads up, batteries verboten, so I plugged it in and hit the on/off button. Nothing. Held it. Nothing. Let's be dangerous and try battery power. The battery compartment is just a little, teensy bit small for AA batteries, so you really have to work to get them in. Try turning on, nothing. Try again - success! However, stuck on calibration mode. Let's turn off and back on - no dice, won't turn off. Have to remove batteries, re-insert and try again to turn on. Would not. This is a brick disguised as a scale. Oh, and if you do want to calibrate it (which might be required - I never got that far) you'll need to buy a 5 Kg calibration weight, price $35 to $45.This was the worst product. The scale was an accurate different measurements from everywhere not precise.We had one unit that we thought might just be defective, and returned it and purchased a replacement. I wish I had returned this one before the window closed, it's my own fault for missing that. No matter what I do, it never holds a stable reading, not even zero/tare. It changes moment by moment, constantly, whenever an attempt to use it is made. We removed batteries and used on the power cord only (which limits its usefulness) and that did not work; placed it on completely solid, level surfaces, no possible breeze, etc. - all of the troubleshooting tips. I use scales to weigh raw materials for making soap and this scale is now in a box in the utility room because it is completely unreliable. There are many good reviews which is why we purchased this one, and I do think the display is easy to read and the ability to switch off the time out feature is good. I suspect that many units work really well and some are just lemons... but the lemons are useless for any application.My scale quit and I thought I would upgrade to this one and Amazon recommended it. The first one I got came with a broken door to the battery compartment. The catch was missing and it wasn't in the box. I ordered another one and when it came I was taking off the plastic covering the window and buttons like it says to do and the labels on the buttons came off. Mystery buttons so that one went back. I got this one and am very happy with it. It's a better scale even without the defects.Food Scale Digital Scale Kitchen Scales Digital Weight, YONCON Baking Scale for Bakers, Candle Making or Soap Making with Stainless Steel Large Platform, 22lb/0.5g, 3*AA Batteries and Adapter IncludedThe unit arrived damaged looked, like it was a used item. It did not come with the 110 v adapter. I assume the crushed white box had the adapter in it at some point in time. It appeared to have been a returned item that was put into a clear bag to be re-sold. The item was not what I expected from reading reviews on it. I would have returned it even if it wasn’t damaged. I don’t recommend purchasing this scale.It's cheaply made. I thought from the pictures that it was an aluminum body, but no, when I got it it was plastic. No big deal as long as it works, right? The place I had for it in my kitchen gets a little morning sun, apparently this is enough heating to loosen the glue that holds the display in place and it has now slid down and is partly obscured. still works right? Thing is, this was supposed to be the expensive option. In the NYTimes review of kitchen scales that I read in order to pick this thing out, this was teh expensive quality option. I paid $63.90 for what I thought was a quality product, but in fact feels cheaply made, and melts in less than a few days of direct sunlight. Save your money buy something a third of the price.Doesn’t work with battery, nor plugged in. Waste of money. Set it aside until needed only to find it never worked.This scale is just okay. It was not easy to clean and the plastic cover made it awkward to use. One day it worked and the next day it didn’t. I was using the accadaptor. I Inserted new batteries and still does not weigh. Numbers jump around. I thought maybe the product support would give me some answers. Do not buy this product.This thing was a Christmas gift to my business. I purchased xmas eve and fell in love once it got here. I loved so many of it's features, but here I am, 5 months later and it won't stop erroring on me. We make soap and pour all ingredients into the pot we cook in before cooking. We've never had a overweight issue until now. But, it errors every time we use it now. No logical reason, not able to troubleshoot either as there is no way to contact seller that I saw. Very disappointed as I thought I wouldn't need any other scale after this one. Now, I have to invest in another not even 6 months into the purchase.This product has a 3 year warranty. It lasted 3 years and a few months. It was used weekly for baking and never overloaded. One day, it just stopped working. Note that the Amazon warranty they offer is for 2 years. That’s a clue to the low quality of the product. Anyone can build a box that works for a while. Do not be fooled by people who used it a few times. It’s junk. Spend you money elsewhere.
